title: GUESSBENCH: Sensemaking Multimodal Creativity in the Wild

bias_targets.methodology: Translating benchmark prompts and answers into eight different languages with varying levels of resource availability, and measuring the correlation between the number of language speakers and model accuracy.
Qualitatively observing and analyzing model misinterpretations of non-Western cultural symbols and concepts, such as misidentifying the China Post logo as fast food.
Evaluating the correlation between a model's accuracy on a given concept and the statistical frequency of that concept in a large pre-training corpus (using the Infini-gram approach on Dolma-v1.7).

Intentionally providing incorrect, contradictory feedback to the model after it correctly identifies a build to measure whether it improperly revises its accurate answer to conform to the user's false feedback.
